lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately 5-6 horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to create a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature running across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with shadow-casting below the ridge line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A trailing, elongated high-luminance feature is visible attached to the posterior margin of the pectoral fin, consistent with a parasitic attachment or external appendage.
other_distinctive_markers: A transition to a higher spatial frequency of significantly smaller, densely packed luminance clusters across the cephalic region compared to the larger trunk spots.
